description: Return THIS vault's write dialect + valid values as a read-only tool: the TaskForge/Settings/dialect.json payload (inline field renames, status symbols + custom display names, priority tokens, TaskNotes config, new-task defaults) the vault's custom property definitions (`properties`: key, type, options with colours, scope, order — the list_properties result) and — with include_guide:true — the TaskForge/Settings/agents.md guide markdown. Same content the taskforge://dialect / taskforge://agents-guide RESOURCES serve, exposed as a TOOL because many MCP hosts never surface resources to the model. Call this BEFORE writing a task to learn the accepted status/priority values and the vault's dialect. Takes no mutation; works whenever the vault resolves.

include_guide.description:
Also return the human/agent-readable dialect guide
(`TaskForge/Settings/agents.md`) as `guide`. Default `false` — the machine
`dialect` alone is usually enough and far smaller.

name: get_dialect
